bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Payments System Modernisation) Bill 2025

name: The majority voted against [amendment (1) on sheet 3392](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2025-09-04.69.1), which was introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), meaning it failed. The amendment was related to reducing conflicts of interest on Reserve Bank boards.
